name: Caretaker Folsom
summary: Along Stormwind’s Canals near the Park, Caretaker Folsom tends the remains of a noble household. He once oversaw the Flintridge estate; now he sells what survived its bloody end.

sections.title: A House in Ruins
sections.body: Folsom followed his father into a life of service as caretaker of the Flintridge estate. That life ended with the massacre of the household. The manor stood abandoned, and its remaining funds eventually ran out. Left to watch over what remained, Folsom now sends the family's surviving heirlooms and possessions to auction.

sections.title: Ties to a Dark Tale
sections.body: Investigators following the bloody history of Stalvan Mistmantle are often sent to Folsom along Stormwind's canal walkways. Grief weighs on him, and he is reluctant to speak. He holds surviving Flintridge possessions and documents that reveal Stalvan's disturbing descent and his eventual disappearance into the shadows of Duskwood.

faq.answer: Caretaker Folsom serves in Stormwind City and once tended the Flintridge family estate. After the massacre that killed the entire family, he was left in charge of their remaining property.

faq.q: Where can I find Caretaker Folsom?
faq.answer: You can find Caretaker Folsom along the Canals' stone walkways in Stormwind City, near the entrance to the Park.

faq.q: What happened to the Flintridge family?
faq.answer: The Flintridge family was massacred at their estate years ago. With no heirs left to claim it, the manor was shuttered and its funds eventually ran out.

faq.q: Why is Folsom selling off family heirlooms?
faq.answer: The Flintridge family's remaining funds eventually ran dry. Folsom now sends what remains of the estate's possessions to auction.

faq.q: What is his role in The Legend of Stalvan?
faq.answer: Folsom helps those piecing together Stalvan Mistmantle's tragedy by sharing the surviving personal effects and clues from the Flintridge manor.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator tracking Duskwood's most infamous murderer, you can turn to Folsom for a living link to the Flintridge household's final days.
